implementation: Register finite BROWSER_CONTROL service and target/observation/action types; do not expose arbitrary CDP or renderer ids.
Freeze target and action parameters, validate target before admission to the existing guest queue and again before publishing results. Change guest generation whenever the native guest is replaced.
Observations keep foreground page/editor focus. Cold saved pages require explicit tab switch. Legacy bridge supports optional profileId/generation and freezes the admitted live guest.

Native input and capture require an explicitly visible page. Input focuses only that guest and checks focus before native dispatch; no hidden-input success claim. Keypress can bind a snapshot element instead of relying on guest focus.
Explicit activation reveals the owning Obsidian leaf before switching the internal page. Close/module-off retire active and queued guest operations.
